newsitem.title: USA: Kleinwort Benson drops Venezuela from portfolio.
newsitem.headline: Kleinwort Benson drops Venezuela from portfolio.

text.p: Kleinwort Benson Securities Ltd said on Monday it had dropped Venezuela from its recommended portfolio of Latin American stocks.
Analysts Rui Antunes and Joe MacHatton said in a report they recommended investors switch most of their money into Mexican stocks. Venezuela had been rated overweight.

"The overvalued Venezuelan bolivar has negative implications for 1997 earnings which are not discounted in stock prices. We are going from overweight to out of the Venezuelan market entirely," they wrote.
"Put most of the money into Mexico. We aren't more positive on Mexico, simply less optimistic about Venezuela."

Venezuela was cut to zero from seven percent of the portfolio and Mexico was raised to 23 from 18 percent. The other five countries in Kleinwort Benson's Latin American portfolio remained unchanged or only slightly changed.
Among recommended Mexican stocks were Grupo Televisa; Tubos de Acero de Mexico SA, or TAMSA; and Grupo Industrial Maseca.
